text:
maya: Found a docs vs runtime mismatch on POST /v1/uploads. PR shows JSON/base64 `file` payload but hosted rejects it (415).

maya: Broken example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"filename\":\"pic.png\",\"file\":\"<base64>\"}'`

ryan: Thanks. Make multipart/form-data the canonical example for Hosted and show JSON/base64 only as an alternate for Dedicated/Private with legacy_uploads enabled. I'll update OpenAPI requestBody to list both media types (oneOf) and render multipart first.

leah: Add SDK convenience snippets (py/js/go) since libs pick multipart automatically. Also call out Hosted max file size 25 MB and suggest streaming for larger files.

sanjay: Confirmed: hosted requires multipart. Dedicated can accept JSON base64 if `legacy_uploads` is enabled. I'll review wording on the PR.

maya: Multipart cURL we'll use:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -F \"file=@./pic.png\" \
  -F \"filename=pic.png\"\n# curl sets Content-Type: multipart/form-data automatically
```

ryan: PR opened WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1001. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/1001/uploads-multipart. Assigning reviews: ryan (author), sanjay (tech), leah (docs).

docs-preview-bot: Preview deployed for PR 1001 — check examples and legacy callout.

leah: Preview looks good; please add a short migration note and a server example for >25MB (413).

ryan: Will update and merge after approvals. :thumbsup:
